expectations.text: PRD 完整记录用户、范围、团队、规模和预算
expectations.evidence: README and 01-product-scope record the platforms, fixed MVP, three Flutter developers, TypeScript familiarity, six months, 20k DAU and ¥8,000 budget.

expectations.text: SPEC 覆盖关键成功及失败行为
expectations.evidence: 01-product-scope and 03-data-api substantively cover OTP lifecycle/frequency, plans, check-in, upload, reminders and coach authorization including errors and idempotency.

expectations.text: DESIGN 覆盖移动端状态与无障碍
expectations.evidence: Product/architecture documents require loading/empty/error/retry states, offline check-in drafts, dynamic type, screen-reader labels, keyboard support and contrast.

expectations.text: 架构推荐与小团队和预算约束一致
expectations.evidence: 02-architecture and 07-decisions-assumptions choose Flutter plus TypeScript modular monolith and record explicit revisit triggers.

expectations.text: 安全部署覆盖中国大陆与移动发布约束
expectations.evidence: 04-security-compliance and 06-operations-cost cover mainland filings, personal information/photos, SMS/push, app stores, backup, rollback and monitoring.

uncertainties: Several detailed numeric defaults are agent-proposed rather than user-confirmed.

suggestions.reason: This eval does not test stable cross-document traceability or readiness gates, so an excellent unstructured baseline can pass all expectations.

eval_feedback.overall: The baseline meets the scenario content bar; add a traceability assertion in a future iteration if structure is part of the desired value.
